formula: X was significantly / considerably higher than Y
note: Базовий, безпечний вислів для помітної, але не екстремальної різниці.
example: Spending on healthcare was significantly higher than spending on education, at $4.2bn against $1.1bn.

exercises.practice: Traffic accidents in the capital were a lot higher than in rural areas, at 340 compared to 60.
exercises.answer: Traffic accidents in the capital were significantly higher than in rural areas, at 340 compared to 60.
exercises.answerNote: Замінили розмовне "a lot higher" на академічне "significantly higher".

exercises.practice: House prices in the capital were a lot higher than in the countryside, at £450,000 compared to £180,000.
exercises.answer: House prices in the capital were considerably higher than in the countryside, at £450,000 compared to £180,000.
exercises.answerNote: "a lot higher than" → considerably higher than.

exercises.practice: Internet speeds in cities were much faster than in rural areas, 120 Mbps versus 15 Mbps.
exercises.answer: Internet speeds in cities were significantly faster than in rural areas, at 120 Mbps versus 15 Mbps.
exercises.answerNote: Додали "at" перед цифрами — типова конструкція для чисел у Task 1.

formula: X dwarfed Y / X was dwarfed by Y
note: Для різкого, разючого контрасту — не для помірної різниці.
example: £62 for the youngest, dwarfing the negligible £8 of the oldest.

exercises.practice: The budget for marketing was much bigger than the budget for research, at $500,000 versus $20,000.
exercises.answer: The budget for marketing dwarfed that for research, at $500,000 versus a mere $20,000.
exercises.answerNote: "much bigger than" → dwarfed; "that for" замінює повторення слова "budget".

exercises.practice: Coffee shop sales were much higher than bookshop sales, at £2.1 million compared to £90,000.
exercises.answer: Coffee shop sales dwarfed bookshop sales, at £2.1 million compared to a mere £90,000.
exercises.answerNote: Додали a mere перед меншим числом, щоб підсилити контраст.

exercises.practice: The number of visitors to the beach was much smaller than the number of visitors to the museum, 200 versus 5,000.
exercises.answer: The number of visitors to the beach was dwarfed by that to the museum, at 200 versus 5,000.
exercises.answerNote: Менше число стоїть першим → пасив was dwarfed by; "that to" замінює повторення "the number of visitors".

note: X перевищив Y — трохи спокійніше і менш образно, ніж dwarfed.
example: Sales in December far exceeded sales in January, reaching 12,000 units against 3,000.

exercises.practice: Attendance at the concert was much higher than at the exhibition, with 8,000 visitors compared to 1,200.
exercises.answer: Attendance at the concert far exceeded that at the exhibition, with 8,000 visitors compared to 1,200.
exercises.answerNote: "much higher than" → far exceeded; "that at" замінює слово "attendance".

exercises.practice: Rice production in Vietnam was much higher than production in Thailand, at 44 million tonnes compared to 20 million.
exercises.answer: Rice production in Vietnam far exceeded that in Thailand, at 44 million tonnes compared to 20 million.
exercises.answerNote: "that in Thailand" = "production in Thailand" — без повторення іменника.

exercises.practice: The company's profit last year was much bigger than the year before, $12 million versus $7 million.
exercises.answer: The company's profit last year far exceeded that of the year before, at $12 million versus $7 million.
exercises.answerNote: "that of the year before" замінює "the company's profit... the year before".

formula: X was almost double / triple / four times that of Y
note: Коли можна порахувати точне співвідношення — у скільки разів більше.
example: Car ownership in the city was almost triple that of the surrounding towns.

exercises.practice: The number of graduates in 2020 was about twice the number of graduates in 2010.
exercises.answer: The number of graduates in 2020 was almost twice that of 2010.
exercises.answerNote: Прибрали повторення "the number of graduates" → замінили на that of.

exercises.practice: Rainfall in April was about double the rainfall in March, 80mm compared to 40mm.
exercises.answer: Rainfall in April was almost double that of March, at 80mm compared to 40mm.
exercises.answerNote: "the rainfall in March" → просто that of March.

exercises.practice: Electricity consumption in summer was roughly three times the consumption in winter.
exercises.answer: Electricity consumption in summer was almost three times that of winter.
exercises.answerNote: Те саме правило: другий раз "consumption" не повторюємо.

formula: There was a marked contrast between X and Y
note: Хороший вступний вислів перед тим, як дати конкретні цифри.
example: There was a marked contrast between male and female participation rates, at 78% and 22% respectively.

exercises.practice: Men and women had very different amounts of free time, 25 hours compared to 14 hours a week.
exercises.answer: There was a marked contrast between the free time available to men and women, at 25 and 14 hours a week respectively.
exercises.answerNote: Просте "very different" → офіційне "a marked contrast between".

exercises.practice: Attitudes to remote work were very different between younger and older employees, 80% in favour versus 25%.
exercises.answer: There was a marked contrast between younger and older employees in their attitudes to remote work, at 80% versus 25%.
exercises.answerNote: Додали "in their attitudes to" — уточнює, ЩО саме контрастує.

exercises.practice: Reading habits changed a lot between 1990 and 2020, from mostly books to mostly screens.
exercises.answer: There was a marked contrast between reading habits in 1990 and in 2020, shifting from books to screens.
exercises.answerNote: "changed a lot" → "a marked contrast between", "shifting from...to" додає деталь.

formula: X and Y were broadly similar / comparable
note: Для НЕвеликої різниці — коли числа близькі, а не контрастні.
example: Coffee and tea consumption were broadly similar, at 48% and 45% respectively.

exercises.practice: The number of male and female students was almost the same, 210 versus 205.
exercises.answer: The numbers of male and female students were broadly comparable, at 210 and 205 respectively.
exercises.answerNote: "almost the same" → broadly comparable; додали "respectively" для стилю.

exercises.practice: Spending on clothes and spending on entertainment were about the same, £45 and £42 a month.
exercises.answer: Spending on clothes and entertainment was broadly similar, at £45 and £42 a month respectively.
exercises.answerNote: "about the same" → "broadly similar" — стандартна академічна заміна.

exercises.practice: The two cities had almost equal populations, 1.2 million and 1.15 million.
exercises.answer: The two cities had broadly comparable populations, at 1.2 million and 1.15 million respectively.
exercises.answerNote: "almost equal" → "broadly comparable".

formula: Only a negligible / minimal proportion was recorded for Y
note: Коли одне значення настільки мале, що майже не варте згадки.
example: Only a negligible proportion of respondents, just 2%, chose to walk to work.

exercises.practice: Very few people, only 3%, used the bicycle to commute.
exercises.answer: Only a negligible proportion of commuters, just 3%, used the bicycle.
exercises.answerNote: "very few... only 3%" → формальніше "only a negligible proportion... just 3%".

exercises.practice: Almost nobody chose the train, just 1% of commuters.
exercises.answer: Only a negligible proportion of commuters, just 1%, chose the train.
exercises.answerNote: "almost nobody" → "only a negligible proportion".

exercises.practice: Hardly any respondents picked "other", only 0.5%.
exercises.answer: Only a minimal proportion of respondents, just 0.5%, selected "other".
exercises.answerNote: "hardly any" → "only a minimal proportion".
